reason: The frozen SSH procedure (hydra) is structurally incapable of producing the required support against the current Metasploitable2 OpenSSH 4.7: hydra/libssh fails MAC negotiation and aborts after one connection.

diagnostic_evidence.hydra_error: kex error : no match for method mac algo client->server

why_identical_rerun_inadequate: The identical frozen hydra invocation is expected to reproduce the same MAC-negotiation failure and the same single-flow outcome, so re-running it is not scientifically justified.

replacement_procedure.description: deterministic fixed-count sequence of independent SSH connection attempts to 192.168.50.20:22 from 192.168.50.10; each attempt is a separate TCP/SSH connection (distinct ephemeral source port) and therefore a distinct selector-matched flow, regardless of whether authentication or negotiation succeeds; legacy KEX/host-key/cipher/MAC algorithms are offered so the handshake reaches the SSH authentication layer of the legacy service.

unchanged_and_reaffirmed.benign_and_portscan_runs: already ACCEPTED; not touched or re-acquired

run_versioning_rule.rule: Each SSH final run ID has versioned capture attempts. Attempt 001 (frozen hydra procedure) is INVALID_LOW_SUPPORT and is preserved, never overwritten, at runs/<id>/provenance.attempt-001.invalid.json. Attempt 002 (this amended procedure) produces the canonical files and runs/<id>/provenance.json used for sealing. Provenance records capture_attempt and traffic_procedure.

stop_after_commit: STOP after this amendment is committed and pushed; no SSH recapture yet, no seal, no scoring.
